sources.snippet: 🗺️ The Problem Taxi-v4 drops an agent into a 5x5 grid world with a simple but surprisingly tricky job: pick up a passenger from one of four colored locations (R, G, Y, B), then drop them off at another.

sources.title: henilsolanki1234-del/SmartTaxi-AI: Smart Taxi AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to Smart Taxi AI, a professional, enterprise-grade taxi fleet management and reinforcement learning platform. This platform demonstrates the integration of a tabular reinforcement learning agent (trained on the standard Gymnasium Taxi-v4 environment) into a realistic SaaS-style fleet dispatch and operational control dashboard.
